facts.text: Ely was founded as a stagecoach station along the Pony Express and Central Overland Route.
The Nevada Northern Railway, preserved as a heritage line, runs through Ely and is one of 2,600 National Historic Landmarks.
Every year the 90‑mile Silver State Classic Challenge race passes near Ely on State Route 318, drawing speed‑hungry drivers worldwide.
The Joana Mine, just two miles north of Ely, exposed the Joana Limestone, a distinctive limestone formation named after the mine.
Ely’s downtown hosts the historic six‑story Hotel Nevada and Gambling Hall, a landmark that survived the town’s mining boom and bust cycles.
Ely is the county seat of White Pine County and sits at 6,200 feet in the Egan Mountains, blending modern amenities with historic treasures.
